verdict.rationale: Mollie ships infrastructure for automation that runs without ongoing human intervention — Subscriptions API 'automatically create[s] recurring payments for you at the interval you specified' and webhooks/webhook-events provide event-driven automation — but nothing shows an AI-native user configuring an autonomous agentic workflow that persists and acts on its own; the MCP server lets an AI client create resources via natural language but is invoked interactively (Claude Desktop/Cursor sessions), not a background daemon. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-orchestrated scheduled/background jobs, autonomous multi-step workflows beyond recurring billing, or a persistent agent runtime tied to the MCP server.
